text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road arrives at the summer 
training camp, a period both for intensive 
training and refreshing oneself for an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Checking her weight reveals she has lost a 
drastic amount... Such was the toll of the 
war of attrition waged against her rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to autumn, she also needed to 
focus on recovering her stamina. —Baked 
under the blazing sun, Narita Top Road's 
summer training camp began.
